name: Article 10, § 3 – 107
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Temporary Decarbonisation Fund
part_text: Amendment (3) Based on its assessment in accordance with paragraph 1, the Commission shall adopt an implementing decision on the financial support to the operators once the resources of the Fund become available, but by 30 June 2029 at the latest. That decision shall constitute a financing decision within the meaning of Article 110 of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2024/2509. The notification of that decision to the competent authority concerned shall constitute an individual legal commitment within the meaning of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2024/2509.
